summary: Implemented a reusable durable contention-start barrier for isolated exclusive-PIN canaries. Distinct workers register append-only BARRIER_ENTRANT_ONLY receipts before the race; the evaluator releases only after the configured distinct-worker threshold, never selects a winner, and times out safely without blocking unrelated allocation. The persisted module and tests match the locally tested bytes; 5/5 deterministic Node tests pass. A protocol document defines atomic CREATE paths, fail-closed receipt validation, ARMING/RELEASED/TIMED_OUT semantics and the requirement that a real canary still prove one ordinary deterministic PIN winner plus at least one genuine loser collision receipt.

Both entrants race the same ordinary deterministic G000001 PIN only after RELEASED.
